title: carney says he spoke recently trump about iran ukraine 2026 09 10
text:
CALGARY, Alberta, Sept 10 (Reuters) - Canadian Prime Minister ​Mark Carney on ‌Thursday said he had spoken to ​U.S. President Donald ​Trump "a couple of times" ⁠recently about ​the war in ​Ukraine and issues related to the Iran conflict.
Carney, ​involved in ​a deepening trade war with ‌the ⁠United States, told reporters in Calgary that he ​had talked ​to ⁠Trump "because part of our ​responsibility is to ​work ⁠together". He did not give ⁠details.
